name: Animated Line Graph
description: A smooth line draws itself on white while one big number counts up with its tip and lands on the final value. Adapted from the graph skill of claude-animation-skills (MIT).

cautions: Never invent data: a scene whose elements carry no series or value draws no number.
One number, one line: no callouts, growth chips or marketing words on the graphic.
The label is a plain noun, not a slogan.

provenance.licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Artem Novitckii (render/LICENSE); fonts Inter and Inter Tight from kit/fonts: SIL OFL 1.1 (render/fonts/OFL-*.txt)
provenance.notes: Adapted: the layout (label, big number, three gridlines, chart box 120..940 x 770..1330 on 1080x1920), the Catmull-Rom line, the count that follows the tip times final/last, the number-size estimate, the landing (soft ring, dotted drop), the timings and eases, the colours and the two fonts. Changed: data from the render payload (a bar or counter series, its value as the final number) instead of a JSON spec; a counter value without a series counts up with no line; a scene without numbers is neutral (axes and the heading, no number); a dim token gives the dark variant; one animation per scene, played faster when the scene is shorter than 4 s; GSAP replaced by a small frame-driven timeline (render/motion.js); fonts embedded as data: URLs; HyperFrames not used. Not copied: the skill's example spec, labels or any demo output.

provenance.ref: venturazz/venstudio docs/plans/style-system.md (Phase 3: Template Lab, first packs from claude-animation-skills)
provenance.notes: The owner chose claude-animation-skills as the first trial source.
